edges.reason: constructor passes msg.sender into _setAdmin, making the caller the initial admin.
ifAdmin modifier compares msg.sender against _admin().
_fallback requires msg.sender to differ from the admin before delegating.
changeAdmin is gated by the ifAdmin modifier, so msg.sender controls whether the admin path executes.
upgrade is gated by ifAdmin; msg.sender decides between the upgrade path and _fallback.
cancelUpgrade is gated by ifAdmin, making msg.sender the authorization input.
prolongLock is gated by ifAdmin, allowing only the caller-equal-admin to extend the lock.
removeTrust is gated by ifAdmin and irreversibly locks upgrades based on msg.sender authority.
proposeToAndCall is admin-gated yet delegatecalls arbitrary calldata supplied by the same caller.
constructor invokes _setAdmin to persist the initial admin.
ifAdmin reads the current admin through _admin().
ifAdmin routes non-admin callers to _fallback.
changeAdmin reads the current admin for the AdminChanged event before updating.
changeAdmin calls _setAdmin to write the new admin.
upgrade checks the timelock by calling _nextLogicBlock().
fallback forwards all unmatched calls to _fallback.
receive forwards plain value transfers to _fallback.
_fallback calls _admin() to verify the caller is not the admin.
_fallback delegates execution into the logic contract via _delegate.
prolongLock calls _proposeBlock() to validate the new lock is strictly larger.
_setNextLogic calls _proposeBlock() to enforce the proposal lock.
_setNextLogic calls _updateBlockSlot() before storing the proposed logic.
proposeToAndCall calls _logic() to decide between immediate set and timelocked proposal.
proposeToAndCall calls _trustMinimized() to check whether trust was already removed.
proposeToAndCall calls _updateBlockSlot() when performing an immediate logic set.
proposeToAndCall calls _setNextLogic() when trust has been removed.
proposeToAndCall invokes the delegatecall on the supplied new logic contract.
_delegate executes the raw assembly delegatecall operation.
The delegatecall inside proposeToAndCall hands control to arbitrary logic that can re-enter the proxy's admin functions before the call returns.
The forwarded delegatecall in _delegate transfers control to the logic contract, which may call back into the proxy fallback and re-enter while state is mid-update.
_admin sloads ADMIN_SLOT.
_setAdmin sstores the new admin into ADMIN_SLOT.
_logic sloads LOGIC_SLOT.
upgrade writes the promoted logic into LOGIC_SLOT.
cancelUpgrade sloads the current LOGIC_SLOT value.
proposeToAndCall writes the new logic directly into LOGIC_SLOT in the untimelocked path.
upgrade sloads NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT as the logic to promote.
cancelUpgrade overwrites NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT with the current logic.
_setNextLogic stores the proposed address into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
_nextLogicBlock sloads NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
_updateBlockSlot stores block.number + 172800 into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
_proposeBlock sloads PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
prolongLock writes the user supplied block into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
_trustMinimized sloads TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT.
removeTrust sstores true into TRUST_MINIMIZED_SLOT.
newAdm parameter is written into admin storage via _setAdmin.
b parameter is stored into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
newLogic parameter provides the delegatecall target in proposeToAndCall.
data parameter provides the calldata executed by the delegatecall.
logic_ parameter is the destination address of the assembly delegatecall.
local logic in upgrade is stored into LOGIC_SLOT.
local logic in cancelUpgrade is stored into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
local nl in _setNextLogic is stored into NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT.
local nlb in _updateBlockSlot is stored into NEXT_LOGIC_BLOCK_SLOT.
delegatecall result is captured in local success and checked with require.
local assembly result holds the success flag returned by the delegatecall in _delegate.

normalization_plan.reason: newAdm is a transient parameter of changeAdmin whose only effect is the admin storage write performed by _setAdmin.
b is a transient parameter consumed immediately by prolongLock and stored into PROPOSE_BLOCK_SLOT.
newLogic is a transient parameter used only as the delegatecall target inside proposeToAndCall.
data is a transient calldata parameter consumed solely by the delegatecall in proposeToAndCall.
logic_ is a transient parameter whose only use is the delegatecall destination in _delegate.
local logic exists only inside upgrade to bridge the NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT load and LOGIC_SLOT store.
local logic exists only inside cancelUpgrade to bridge the LOGIC_SLOT load and NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT store.
nl is a transient local holding the proposed logic before the NEXT_LOGIC_SLOT write in _setNextLogic.
nlb is a transient local holding block.number + 172800 before the block slot write.
success only buffers the delegatecall return value immediately checked by require inside proposeToAndCall.
result only buffers the delegatecall success flag used by the assembly switch in _delegate.
